title: Accelerating Single-Pass SGD for Generalized Linear Prediction
summary: We study generalized linear prediction under a streaming setting, where each iteration uses only one fresh data point for a gradient-level update. While momentum is well-established in deterministic optimization, a fundamental open question is whether it can accelerate such single-pass non-quadratic stochastic optimization. We propose the first algorithm that successfully incorporates momentum via a novel data-dependent proximal method, achieving dual-momentum acceleration.
